_about: James S. Reid (1846-1926), Professor of Ancient History at Cambridge: The Municipalities of the Roman Empire (Cambridge, 1913), and his Cicero editions, raw IA: M. Tulli Ciceronis Academica, the text revised and explained (London: Macmillan, 1885), and the speeches Pro Sulla (1882; 1886 issue), Pro Archia (new edition, 1889), Pro Balbo (1890) and Pro Milone (1894; stereotyped 1897), edited for schools and colleges (Cambridge University Press); Latin text with English commentary, kept per the 2026-10-23 reasoning on text-facing editions. His translation of the Academics (1880) is on the cicero shelf (cicero-reid-academics-1880).
